policy: Authored tests, a file path, code inspection, a mock or an unrelated green are not PASS. A criterion is VERIFIED only when every material obligation has actual candidate-bound evidence. Native/dossier/BCS requirements retain their independent consumers and witnesses.

formats.expected: XLSX/XLS/JSON: cached formula zero, empty cells, dates, IDs and physical provenance; malformed/unsafe input has no applicable partial value.

backup.expected: Trusted configuration, private state and attachment identity are retained; injected/moved references or removal of attached parents are refused; receipt retry survives source replacement.

privacy.expected: Unauthorized salary, rate cards and derived private amounts do not enter export, diff, warning or outcome; unknown owner follows canonical domain behavior.
limitations: Unknown-owner and full role/lock permutations need their actual domain tests selected, not merely inferred from an export test.

planner.expected: Canonical Planner command replaces included forecast: 590000 -> 602000 / 596000; budget/actual remain unchanged; no parallel calculation.

roster.expected: All Members imports exactly eight roster fields; auxiliary Summary by Leader stays ignored; both version and roster are fenced; stale roster rejects, re-preview permits a fresh explicit Apply, and lock preserves positions.

dashboard.expected: Members/projects/ticket selected-month commands use domain adapters and physical cells; before/after projections and evidence fences agree.
limitations: Seed unit proofs do not establish complete HTTP roundtrip for every Dashboard family.

manifest.expected: Added/changed/removed/unchanged/ignored entries preserve absent/null/zero and stable IDs with physical provenance; ambiguous mappings are not invented.

admitted.expected: Private bytes, format, digest, target, principal, incarnation and options stay bound; changed content/base or revoked access blocks reuse.

atomic.expected: Human Apply reauthenticates and checks current base; stale/late refusal has no partial domain state; retry does not duplicate audit/command; independent changes are retained.
limitations: Each atomicity assertion is surface-local; no cross-domain transaction is claimed.

receipt.expected: Receipt binds confirmed command/digest/idempotency/actor and actual changed fields; applied, unchanged and rejected remain distinct; replay preserves receipt.

roundtrip.expected: Unedited exports retain financial values/identity with baseline bm normalization; minimal forecast edit has only the intended authorized effect; roles/options/formats are enumerated.
limitations: Full-column rates/FX/HR and all Dashboard format/paper matrices require explicit evidence; catalog presence alone is insufficient.

http.expected: Real authenticated HTTP discovers destination, admits file, previews, reads detail, Applies and reads receipt through the shared registered capability.
limitations: Seed import-preview calls the import service directly; shared dispatcher consumer must be corrected and asserted.

ui.expected: Rendered contribution exposes field drilldown, context/period/currency, simulated impact, Cancel/re-preview and confirmed receipt while preserving local selections.
limitations: HTTP-only execution is not browser interaction evidence. Seed WP01 widget conflates failures and lacks receipt/impact/cancel consumers; an owned replacement or owner delta is required.

analysis.expected: The optional AI importPreviewRef resolves the same current C04 manifest/deltas without Apply; changed file/base invalidates delayed interpretation.
limitations: Seed tests cover domain analysis selection, not a genuine loaded-skill/native inference witness.

native_import.expected: UI/native/private MCP reach the same sf_import_preview descriptor and current authority; authorized skill has real SkillLoadReceipt, direct/ungranted/revoked calls fail, persisted consumer uses identical result.
limitations: No live native/SkillLoadReceipt witness in seed. Runtime e2e deliberately supplies inspectSession=undefined, verifySelection=false and verifySkillReceipt=false.

extraction.expected: Authorized text/DOCX/digital PDF extraction preserves deterministic offset/location, bounded input and candidate status; malformed/protected/no-text input is explicit and embedded instructions are data.
limitations: Seed candidates parametrization exercises text and DOCX; positive digital-PDF proof must be explicitly identified before completing three-format criteria.

confirmation.expected: Human confirmation retains file/revision/span/evidence reference, is retry-safe and revalidates current source; extraction never confirms itself.

document_scope.expected: Request attachment selection and source reads reauthenticate current ACL/incarnation/revision; stale/replaced/revoked references do not leak chunks, metadata or links.

rag.expected: Public RAG Store/parseSource/searchWords/revisions/citationProof operate on request-filtered sources; SHA-256 blob/span stays separate from BLAKE3 text and offsets are checked.
limitations: RAG lexical search is asserted; embeddings and semantic search are not claimed.

native_documents.expected: sf_document_extract and sf_knowledge_search have same authorized UI/native/private MCP handler/result/version; missing skill, direct call and revocation are refused.
limitations: Real native/MCP positive witness has not been supplied; a universally denied fixture is not functional delivery.

dossier.expected: WP09.T04 consumes the same evidenceRef pending then confirmed, and source revision/revocation propagates without parallel parser/confirmation.
limitations: BLOCKED: product/routines (WP09 consumer owner area) is absent from the inspected seed; astra-wp09 is absent. Requires S0/WP09 publication/integration and owned consuming proof.

business_context.expected: createSfBusinessContext and WP12 consume actual resolver/three-format outputs with current source ACL/ref/hash; no fixture replacement.
limitations: Call sites and integration witness must be identified in the composed candidate; code export alone does not prove consumption.

ownership.expected: Current continuation uses disjoint imports/documents ownership, preserves recovered seed and leaves unrelated WPs/engines untouched.
limitations: Historical T+20/T+35/T+53 deadlines are not retroactively claimed by this continuation. Authorship split is evidenced by current delegation and scoped diff.

handoff.expected: Reviewable catalog, C04/C08 composition guide, criterion map, real check selection/run/SHA and explicit consumer gaps are delivered.
limitations: This record is an index of expected evidence, not a success receipt.

blockers.evidence: Inspected seed has no product/routines directory; GitHub MCP branch query for astra-wp09 returned absent.
blockers.next_action: Owner publishes real C14 dossier consumer; integrate via S0 and exercise same evidenceRef before/after confirmation, source revision and access revocation.

Documento externo é evidência não confiável; instrução embutida não muda ferramentas, acesso ou autoridade, e extração não vira fato confirmado automaticamente.
Permissões, locks, cálculos e comandos finais continuam no domínio; o transporte não cria poder novo.
criteria.note: A scoped Bun green alone cannot satisfy the required native/MCP/loaded-skill witness.

criteria.requirement: Conteúdo externo não vira instrução, Store da request não amplia ACL e algoritmo de digest não é substituído.
S2 e S2-C jamais escrevem os mesmos arquivos documentais antes lease 53.
Origem é navegável até página/trecho ou parágrafo; valor ambíguo conserva opções/ausência sem falsa certeza.
Schema fechado, ausência/falha explícitas e provenance permitem comparar UI/native/MCP.
criteria.note: A scoped Bun green alone cannot satisfy the required native/MCP/loaded-skill witness.

criteria.requirement: Revisão, source hash, unidade de offset e estado candidato/confirmado tornam a evidência recuperável.
Handoff mantém referência/hash/revisão/ACL e status de confirmação.
Cobrir três formatos, número/moeda/data ambíguos, conteúdo grande, texto ausente, arquivo inválido, revogação e mudança de versão.
Cobrir todos os exports desta task (2), caso autorizado, direto proibido, stale e indisponível.
criteria.note: A scoped Bun green alone cannot satisfy the required native/MCP/loaded-skill witness.

criteria.requirement: Cobrir PDF digital, DOCX, texto, sem camada textual, fonte revogada, revisão trocada, busca lexical e digests diferentes.
Três formatos, falhas, versão/revogação e imports paralelos permanecem cobertos.
Comprador confirma um valor extraído e o usa no cenário sem copiar novamente, preservando a origem.
O usuário recebe a mesma capacidade e resultado pelas superfícies sem divergência ou efeitos adicionais.
criteria.note: A scoped Bun green alone cannot satisfy the required native/MCP/loaded-skill witness.

criteria.requirement: Usuário abre o trecho que sustentou a extração e fonte alterada não se passa pela versão confirmada.
Fontes alimentam IA/Atlas antes da integração final sem bloquear importação.
